intro: Toot Sweet Candy Cart is a candy cart hire business based in Chelmsford, Essex. They hire out a handmade Victorian candy cart, dressed with sweets and decorations, and offer a variety of sweet packages.
about: Toot Sweet Candy Cart describes itself as a candy cart hire business in Chelmsford, Essex. They hire out their handmade Victorian candy cart and offer a variety of sweet packages to go with it. The cart is white, with spoked wheels and the business name painted on the front panel. Their round grey logo shows an illustrated cart and carries the words 'EST 2020', and their X account dates from March 2020.

Photos of the cart show it dressed with balloon garlands, bunting, flowers, cakes, doughnuts and jars of sweets. In June 2020 they restyled the cart as a brunch and afternoon-tea display, saying they had 'tried something a little different with the Candy Cart'. The display had a Victoria sponge, scones, sandwiches, watermelon, champagne, flowers, a balloon garland and a personalised 'On Weekends We Brunch' sign.

In June 2020 the business also made personalised sweet boxes. Each held 12 different sweets and Ferrero Rochers and came with a choice of colour theme and a personalised gift tag and message. The boxes were posted out, and free delivery was offered around Chelmsford and Ingatestone at the time. Their most recent visible public posts date from June 2020, so planners should check current availability, packages and pricing directly with the business, for example through their Facebook page.

gaps: The business has no live website. The domain tootsweetcandycart.co.uk is not registered, and every archived copy of it (2021 to 2024) is a Wix 'connect your domain' error page with no content.
It is not known whether the business is still trading. Its latest visible public posts date from June 2020.

The business does not publish a current price. The only from-price (£300 per event) comes from a third-party directory listing last updated in February 2025, and the sweet-box prices date from June 2020.
The business does not say in its own words which event types it serves. Its only hints are hashtags such as #gardenparty and #afternoontea on one styled set-up.

Its exact location and service area are unconfirmed. The X profile says Chelmsford, Essex, and an unverified search summary of the Instagram bio mentions Harlow, Essex. Travel range and delivery areas for cart hire are not stated.
The Facebook and Instagram pages could not be viewed logged out, so any contact details, bio text or recent posts there are unverified.
Guest capacity has not been confirmed by the business. The only figure (10–100 guests) comes from a third-party directory.
Licences, insurance and booking or cancellation policies are not stated by the business. A third-party directory field for licences and insurance reads 'No'.
The current sweet package contents and the full list of what the cart hire includes are not published.
